subject: Kickoff: microscope focus-quality QC for imaging partners
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off the microscope image-quality track (window: Apr 20 – Jul 27). The asset is our open-source deep-learning focus-quality classifier (the BMC Bioinformatics method) plus the Focus_check script, which renders whole-plate montages per channel so a lab tech can eyeball data quality in one screen instead of clicking through thousands of sites.

What the research unlocks as a product: an automated QC gate for the two imaging partners in the pipeline — bad-focus plates get flagged before anyone wastes a week of analysis on them.

Rough milestones: mid-May, Fiji macro packaging cleaned up (install flow is still "edit the macro by hand"); end of June, the montage pipeline running on partner plates; mid-July, public-facing benchmark of focus classifiers so partners can compare methods.

Can you come back with staffing and any platform asks by May 1?

Thanks,
Lucia
